description: Defines internal static methods for recording storage-related metrics such as latencies and error counts using OpenTelemetry-like instruments. It creates histograms and counters for storage read/write/clear operations and errors, and provides methods for recording these metrics with associated metadata.

classes.name: StorageInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing metrics instrumentation for storage operations within Orleans runtime, including latency measurements and error counting.

methods.name: OnStorageRead
methods.description: Records a storage read latency metric with associated metadata such as provider type, state name, and state type.

methods.name: OnStorageWrite
methods.description: Records a storage write latency metric with associated metadata such as provider type, state name, and state type.

methods.name: OnStorageReadError
methods.description: Increments the read error counter with associated metadata.

methods.name: OnStorageWriteError
methods.description: Increments the write error counter with associated metadata.

methods.name: OnStorageDelete
methods.description: Records a storage delete (clear) latency metric with associated metadata.

methods.name: OnStorageDeleteError
methods.description: Increments the delete error counter with associated metadata.
